settings.heading: The fifth point isn’t on your skin

settings.content: Four of the five you could measure. The fifth you can’t — which is why it’s usually left out.
Expecting a flush produces the same vascular response as the flush itself.
Learn to brace for it, and you hand the loop a live signal. Continuously. Even in rooms that aren’t warm.
One account says it best: “even when the room isn’t warm, I get so anxious about flushing that it happens.”
It arrives before the trigger. Not imagined — predicted. And the prediction is itself the input.
There’s no cream for anticipation. So the useful question isn’t what to apply. It’s which of the five is doing the most work. That differs for every face.
